description: This file defines the HomeScreen widget for a Flutter restaurant app, including various UI components such as profile header, status card, quick actions, weather recommendations, and bottom navigation bar.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that builds the main home screen with profile, status, quick actions, weather recommendations, and bottom navigation.

classes.name: _ProfileHeader
classes.description: A StatelessWidget displaying restaurant profile information.

classes.name: _StatusCard
classes.description: A StatelessWidget showing whether the restaurant is open and operating hours.

classes.name: _QuickActions
classes.description: A widget displaying a grid of quick action tiles for navigation to different features.

classes.name: _ActionTile
classes.description: A widget representing an individual actionable tile with icon and label.

classes.name: _WeatherRecommendations
classes.description: A widget presenting weather-based food recommendations placeholder.

classes.name: _BottomNav
classes.description: A widget for the bottom navigation bar of the app.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for HomeScreen that assembles the main page layout.
